items.headline: Nebius upsizes convert to $5B and forces exchange of $800M in existing notes for shares; stock dives 14% before rebounding
items.note: Upsized from $4.5B to $5B and paired with an $800M note-for-equity swap on the 2029/2031 converts — a realized, dilutive refinancing that shows a neocloud leaning on capital markets rather than cash flow to fund GPU buildout.

items.headline: SoftBank readies record ¥1tn retail bond as Nvidia and Oracle CDS spreads widen further
items.note: Nvidia's 5-year CDS hit 80.77bp (+90% YTD, more than doubled since May) and Oracle's stayed above 200bp as SoftBank moves to raise a record retail bond to fund its AI/OpenAI commitments — concrete credit-spread widening tied to AI-infra counterparties.

items.headline: CoreWeave, Nebius, TeraWulf slide as Anthropic's $65B and OpenAI's $40B ARR land below whisper numbers
items.note: CoreWeave -6.8%, Nebius -5.2%, TeraWulf -6.5% on the combination of an AI-revenue miss versus expectations at the two largest model labs and the WSJ's fresh $3T sizing of hyperscaler off-balance-sheet lease/purchase commitments — a revenue-disappointment signal feeding directly into neocloud counterparty risk.

items.headline: Nvidia scales OpenAI/SB Energy financing backstop down to ~$120B from a rumored $250B, still negotiating up to $350B in GPU financing
items.note: SEC 8-K quantifies Nvidia's guaranty exposure on the SB Energy-built, OpenAI-leased Ohio campus; even scaled back, it's a concrete, dollar-sized escalation of the circular-financing/SPV web the credit thesis is watching for collection risk if AI revenue disappoints.

items.headline: Anthropic-tied Nexus Data Centers (Hubbard, TX) closes $1.3B private-credit loan inside a $16B project-finance package
items.note: Single-tenant (Anthropic) concentration risk on a large private-credit-funded campus with its own gas plant — not distress on its own, but adds to the private-credit book of AI-tenant-concentrated debt this thesis tracks.
